en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.

zh: 掃羅打發人窺探大衛的房屋，要殺他。那時，大衛作這金詩，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。

ja: 指揮者のために。「滅ぼさないでください」に合わせて。ダビデの詩。サウルが人を遣わし、ダビデを殺すためにその家を見張らせたとき。

p.src: 1  Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

ja: してください。 私に
en: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
u.src: 1  Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

p.src: 2  Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
u.src: 2  Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

p.src: 3  For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

en: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.
u.src: 3  For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

p.src: 4  I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

ja: 私は何も悪いことをしていないのに、
らは襲いかかろうと構えている。 起き上がり、見て、私を
en: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
u.src: 4  I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

p.src: 5  You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

ja: には、あわれみを示さないでください。 セラ。
en: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.
u.src: 5  You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

p.src: 6  They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

en: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.
u.src: 6  They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

p.src: 7  Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

ja: いているものか」と彼らは言う。
en: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
u.src: 7  Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

p.src: 8  But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

en: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.
u.src: 8  But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

p.src: 9  Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

ja: の高いやぐらだからだ。
en: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.
u.src: 9  Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

p.src: 10  My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

en: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
u.src: 10  My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

p.src: 11  Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

ja: れてしまわないためだ。
らし、引き降ろしてください。
en: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.
u.src: 11  Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

p.src: 12  For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

ja: らが自分の高ぶりに捕らえられるようにしてください。 彼らが口にする
en: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.
u.src: 12  For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

p.src: 13  Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

ja: ぼし尽くしてください。
ぼし尽くして、いなくしてください。
らせてください。 地の果てに至るまで。 セラ。
en: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.
u.src: 13  Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

p.src: 14  At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

ja: をうろつき回らせてください。
en: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.
u.src: 14  At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

p.src: 15  They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

en: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.
u.src: 15  They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

p.src: 16  But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

en: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
u.src: 16  But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

p.src: 17  To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

ja: は私の高いやぐら、私をあわれんでくださる
en: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
u.src: 17  To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
